title: Surprise midnight release. Stompworks a Roguelike with mech building.
author: Mekkablood
selftext:
A classic revenge story with cel-shaded fully customizable mechs. Buy the right parts, take out the enemies, and don't die. 18 torsos, 14 sets of legs and 27 weapons, you retain the skins you unlock even after death, but not the parts. It's been a lot of fun making this, and I hope you like it.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383780/Stompworks/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383780/Stompworks/?beta=0)

It was made with Opus 5.5 extra high. No mcp's just had Opus do the models within a three.js environment. Started off with the first mech, then built parts from there, a basic level, then added the gameplay and it took a goosebumps book worth of prompts to make what you see here. Will be working on changing up the sound a little bit.
